title: Training Note: First and Repeat Referral Bonus, Residential Electricity Supply
content:
Training note, Residential Electricity Supply referral program.

**Q. What does the referral count bonus depend on?**
A. On the referral credit lines already on the referring agreement, the agreement that receives the new credit. When the referring agreement carries no referral credit line yet, the first-referral bonus of 10.00 USD is added; when it carries one or two, the repeat-referral bonus of 5.00 USD is added; when it carries three or more, nothing is added.

**Q. Which lines are counted?**
A. Every referral credit line on that agreement's bills, whenever posted; lines on the customer's other agreements are not counted. The credit being worked out is not yet on the bill and is not counted.

| Referral credit lines already on the referring agreement | Referral count bonus |
|---|---|
| none | 10.00 USD |
| 1 or 2 | 5.00 USD |
| 3 or more | nothing |

**Q. Where are the boundaries?**
A. 0 lines take 10.00 USD; 1 line takes 5.00 USD; 2 lines take 5.00 USD; 3 lines take nothing.
